name: Lena Lighting S.A.
summary: Lena Lighting S.A., a Polish enterprise, specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of professional illumination systems. While primarily serving the Polish market, the company boasts a significant international presence. Its diverse product range encompasses architectural lighting, featuring office luminaires, bulkheads, downlights, industrial fixtures, floodlights, streetlights, accent lighting, projectors, emergency systems, and advanced lighting controls. Furthermore, Lena Lighting S.A. offers an exhaustive selection of lighting tailored for construction sites and workshops. This includes robust floodlights, general site illumination, portable LED fittings, specialized machine lamps, incandescent and battery-powered hand lamps, tripods, portable fluorescent units, and assorted electrical materials. Their specialized offerings also extend to bactericidal and virucidal lamps, headlamps, dedicated workshop lights, lamps for paint booths, and cable hand lamps. Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland, the company actively exports its solutions to approximately 70 markets globally.
